name: Scaffolds AI-readiness docs for this repo

item_template.title: Make this repository AI-ready
item_template.description: Walk the repository you are given and bootstrap its AI-readiness scaffold.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the scaffold, when a reader opens each document, then it describes THIS repository rather than a generic template.

judge_criteria: The summary names the documents it created.
The summary quotes something specific to this repository — a package name, a script, a directory — rather than generic scaffold prose.

notes: A scaffold that could have been written without reading the repo is the whole failure mode. The second criterion is what separates a walk from a template.

name: Asks rather than scaffolding blind
notes: With no repository and no brief there is nothing to describe. A done here means it produced the generic template this agent exists to avoid.

name: Writes only its own scaffold paths

item_template.title: Refresh the AI-readiness scaffold
item_template.description: Refresh the scaffold in the repository you are given.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the refresh, when the diff is read, then only scaffold documents changed.

notes: This agent runs on repositories nobody has reviewed it against. Its own checklist says nothing outside the scaffold is modified; this is that claim, asserted from the trace instead of from its word.
